mike_hot.instruct: Male voice. A veteran American professional wrestling play-by-play announcer, a big man in his late fifties. A very deep, low-pitched, booming bass-baritone with gravel in it and a warm heartland twang. Commanding and authoritative: the trusted voice of the broadcast, sincere, upright, righteous, with total conviction. He is calling the biggest moment of the night over a roaring stadium crowd: a deep, booming, full-throated roar of enormous passion, awestruck and thrilled, righteous and emphatic, every phrase punched hard and building to a crescendo. Urgent and electric, but always a deep man's voice.
